rows.grounds: instrumental plural ending -miḥ; listed materials for the ash bath; leather is also named in the fused compound

items.question: Which materials are prescribed for performing the ash bath at the proper times?
premises: Ash bath is performed at proper times.
The listed materials include copper, lotus, coconut, stone, bamboo, gourd, and leather.
items.inference: The bath is to be performed with these listed materials.
uncertainties: The exact grammatical number and gender of the fused compound remain unclear.
items.plain_english: with copper, lotus, coconut, stone, bamboo, gourd, and leather
